status_logging: small status.json (counts+at most2active rows), clock.json cumulative wall; no growing540prefix logging

api.run: run(plan_path=PLAN, output=None)->summary; authentic release required before transport import
api.launcher: tools/start_geobc_coverage_fetch.ps1 -Start; hidden bundled WindowsPython, system proxy unchanged

root_release.source_pins: exact current plan.source_sha256; must contain and match four fetch dependencies

contract_reuse: Frozen scientific/acquisition digests + only four fetch sources; future data/train source additions excluded

summary_schema.files: ordered540 same original receipt fields plus cad_id/role
summary_schema.complete_requires: all540 downloaded or existing complete files size+SHA reverified in this invocation

file_receipt.checksum_origin: first observed received bytes, no independent upstream checksum or HF identity

attempt_ledger: .attempts/<runUUID>_<sequence>.json; real progress lower bounds/terminal results, open interruption retained
lock: .fetch.lock O_EXCL; Windows PID + creation_tick + hostname; proven stale lock archived, unknown/alive refuses duplicate
resume: Verify complete binary sizes/SHA; partial failed requests restart same source, no HTTP range resume claim; one attempt/file/invocation

budgets.overshoot: Existing in-flight chunks/requests may exceed nominal ceiling; actual bytes and wall reported, stop issuing new tasks once exceeded

budget_policy: Stop new requests at cumulative ceiling, finish at most2 inflight, report observed overshoot; interrupted unknown bytes conservatively reserved, never invented exact
failure_policy: Retain failures and continue remaining frozen files if within budgets, no auto retry loop or replacement
